status: exploratory follow-up after all earlier AI/ML/hybrid results were inspected

input_sets.AI3: same component raw archived conditions1/2/3, in that order
input_sets.AI8: same component raw archived conditions1..8, in ascending order
input_sets.AI8ML: same eight raw codes followed by same-component fixed-image ML hard code from the previous fully nested hybrid branch

features: Only same-limb categorical AI predictions, plus ML hard prediction for AI8ML. NA=0 distinct category. No expert values, true correctness flags, other limbs, metadata, timestamps, lux, recording ID, notes/status/evidence/prior-influence text, or probabilities. Load task-known1.
target: unchanged paired-image expert consensus: back1-4, arms1-3, legs2/3/4/5/7. Expert labels are training targets and held-out scoring references, never predictor columns.
AI_dependency: All eight conditions are fixed archived outputs; not eight independent experts. Conditions4/8 use condition1 prior,5/7 use2,6 uses3 within the same AI version. Prior-source fields and prior components/fullcodes must exactly match corresponding archived AI outputs, not expert references.
encoding: train-fitted OneHotEncoder with predeclared domain repeated per3/8/9columns, dense float64, dropNone, handle_unknownerror. No arithmetic averaging of code labels and no ordinal numeric interpretation.

Logistic.settings: balanced L2 lbfgs, l1_ratio0, tol0.0001, max_iter5000, seed20261029

RF.settings: 200 trees, min_samples_leaf3, balanced_subsample, seed20261029,n_jobs1, other sklearn defaults; identical two-setting budget across input sets

RBF_SVM.settings: SVC kernelrbf gamma scale, balanced, probabilityFalse, no additional scaling of onehot inputs, other sklearn defaults; identical grid across input sets

selection: per component/version/system mean3inner-fold fixed-class macro-F1 including zero-support classes; ties first ordered candidate. No joint fullcode/test-based selection. Family search budgets differ (4/2/4), disclosed rather than treated as matched across families.
fallback: single training target class -> training-class DummyClassifier; empty training ->error. Missing classes do not alter splits or label sets.

nested_ML_cache.source: ai_ml_hybrid_v1/results/<context>/context_<fold>.joblib, all13contexts pinned by exact SHA256 before new accuracy
nested_ML_cache.safety: validate old hybrid protocol freeze and seal, core source/feature hashes, matching outer/inner/further split identities and seed. Reuse only per-context arrays, not all181 OOF tables as training features.
nested_ML_cache.inner_C_selection: each outer innerU/V: AI8ML meta training uses rawAIU+MLcrossfitWithinU from saved further3fold grouped/purged subsets; validation uses rawAIV+MLfitU(V). No V/outertest reference labels inform training features or fits.
nested_ML_cache.outer_final: meta training uses rawAIT+crossfitMLWithinT; outertest uses rawAIH+MLfitT(H). AI3/AI8 use rawfixedAIcodes only. No new image ML fits or tuning in this branch; fixed image settings remain exactly those declared in old hybrid protocol.
nested_ML_cache.base_settings: back paired generic+torso RF200depth5leaf3; arms side generic RBF-SVC C10; legs paired generic+geometry RF200depth5leaf3. Original availability gates unchanged.

validation.main: same five outer/three inner GroupKFold recording+floor(seconds/60), shuffleTrue; <=10sec same-recording training purge
validation.transfer: both directions, same worker, source-only fitting/selection with60sec blocks; not new-person validation or clothing causality
validation.further: same old grouped/purged further3folds insideU, seed20261029+outerfold+10000+innerindex1based; reuse exact source contexts only

codes: archived condition3 fullcodes preserved, not reconstructed. Other systems construct three nonzero predictions+fixedload1 or NA if any0. Valid AI leg1/6 inputs and baseline predictions are retained, scored wrong against observed targets. Learned classifiers cannot emit target classes absent in training, including1/6; may predict a class absent from all input codes or fill all-NA input. No calibrated confidence claim.
metrics: cross-family comparisons at same input set
parity_controls: archived_both/fixed_image_ML/NAfill must equal old hybrid predictions; AI3_Logistic must equal old ai_codes_logistic in every context; old three-code+ML Logistic is reported as historical matched-recipe anchor, not retrained or a new independent sample.
storage: outer selected model objects omitted from result caches to avoid redundant large forests; candidate predictions/selection/support retained. Full-training201 model objects frozen for all9systems. Independent selected-fit reproduction verifies sample outer models; do not claim all outer models were independently refitted.
frozen_role: all new systems secondary exploratory candidates; previous primary and all secondary seals unchanged
limits: one worker, two recordings, irregular purposive frames, repeated adaptive reuse. No population CIs/p-values, general superiority, originality, calibrated-confidence, human-review savings, fresh-raw-image or new-worker result.
